mostWorthwhile.text: Recycling rain through the atmosphere was worthwhile because it showed that evaporated water remains in the system rather than disappearing.

leastWorthwhile.text: The hot-ground passage was confusing after the ground had already been described as cool enough to retain water.

continue.text: I would continue: the physical explanations and the prospect of seeing water accumulate are interesting, despite the confusing temperature sequence.
